title: Reese shines again as Dream down Valkyries to lead WNBA Finals
summary: Angel Reese produced another dominant all-round display as the Atlanta Dream routed the Golden State Valkyries 97-71 to take a 2-1 lead in the best-of-seven WNBA Finals on Wednesday.
